theorem p11 (n : ℕ) : n ^ 2 % 4 = 0 ∨ n ^ 2 % 4 = 1 := by
  have h : n % 4 = 0 ∨ n % 4 = 1 ∨ n % 4 = 2 ∨ n % 4 = 3 := by omega
  rw [Nat.pow_mod]
  rcases h with h | h | h | h <;> simp [h]
